name: ui/status-badge
title: StatusBadge
summary: A pill-shaped lifecycle label (stable, beta, alpha or deprecated), each status tinted with one of the Seven Minerals at 10% behind the mineral itself. One contract for the Astro, React and Mzizi Roots builds.

props.name: status
props.description: The lifecycle stage. Also the label when no children are given.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Optional label; the status itself when omitted.

behaviour: data-status always names the status, the default included.
stable is malachite, beta is cobalt, alpha is gold and deprecated is terracotta, struck through: each status's mineral at 10% as the fill and the full mineral as the text.
The label is the status itself unless a label is given, so the status is always written out.

aria: Meaning is in the written status, never colour alone; the strike-through on deprecated is reinforced by the word.

theming.brandOverlay: None: the colour is the status's mineral, never the brand accent.

noJs.without: Everything: the component is markup with no script.

contract:
contract
  slot is "status-badge"
  portal is "https://mzizi.dev/components/status-badge"
  class has "rounded-full"
  class has "uppercase"
  when default shows span "stable"
  when default class not contains "line-through"
  when beta shows span "beta"
  when beta class not contains "line-through"
  when alpha shows span "alpha"
  when alpha class not contains "line-through"
  when deprecated shows span "deprecated"
  when deprecated class has "line-through"
end
